summary.text: Alan Branson is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 59 in Guilford County since April 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A former Guilford County commissioner, he owns a trucking business, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Alan Branson served on the Guilford County Board of Commissioners, District 4, leaving office in 2020, according to Ballotpedia.
The Guilford County Republican Party appointed Branson to North Carolina House District 59 on April 10, 2024, to replace Jon Hardister, and he assumed office on April 24, 2024.
The General Assembly lists his occupation with Stout Trucking, Inc.
The Republican primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
